name: rapid-turret
author: MaKyS0
description: Rapid Arsenal: very fast-firing turrets (Rapid, Pulse lasers, Buckshot shotguns, Mortar artillery), shield walls, drills, conveyors, power generators, crafters, bridges, storage and its own alloy, and mech, air, naval and legged units. Pure JSON mod (no Java/JS), so it works on desktop, Android and iOS.
